Lazarus-linked intrusion clusters are split by espionage and revenue, and a fake IT worker programme earns revenue and gains access. The report covers laundering through China, Russia, Southeast Asia and Cambodia, and 2024 to 2026 institutional changes. Attributions and cluster mappings are the authors' own and are hedged.

hedges: It must be noted that certain discrepancies will remain and these entities are subject to frequent change.
According to some DPRK-watchers, North Korean intelligence agencies have continuously been reorganized and/or redesignated over time.
The June 2026 renaming of the MSS to the NIA is described as likely a sign of an expansion of its competencies.
Reaper's growth in 2024 is described as likely and is based on what analysts say about the United Front Department.
Kimsuky is described by some DPRK experts as a mega-cluster; the GRIB affiliation (3rd and/or 5th Bureau) is debated among the CTI community.
Bureau 121's presence at a Shenyang hotel during the 2014 Sony operation is only speculated, and the methods are said to likely enable plausible deniability.
The change of IT worker communications to English around October 2022 is assessed to follow a directive.
Deployments in Guinea and Nigeria are described as likely, based on what the Chollima group reports.
